extensive.title: Welcome to the Riverside Community Centre
extensive.topic: 社区中心活动与设施介绍

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Riverside Community Centre.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好，欢迎来到河畔社区中心。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: My name is Priya, and I'm the coordinator here.
sentences.zh: 我叫普里娅，是这里的协调员。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: I'd like to tell you about the classes and activities we run this autumn.
sentences.zh: 我想跟大家介绍一下我们今年秋天开设的课程和活动。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: The centre is open from eight in the morning until ten at night, seven days a week.
sentences.zh: 中心每天早上八点开到晚上十点，一周七天。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: On the ground floor you'll find the café and the main hall.
sentences.zh: 在一楼你会看到咖啡厅和主厅。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: The hall is used for yoga on weekday mornings and for badminton in the evenings.
sentences.zh: 主厅在工作日上午用于瑜伽，晚上用于羽毛球。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: Upstairs there are two small rooms, which can be booked by local groups.
sentences.zh: 楼上有两个小房间，可供本地团体预订。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: Booking costs twelve pounds an hour, but registered charities pay nothing.
sentences.zh: 预订费用是每小时十二英镑，但注册慈善机构免费。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: Our most popular course is the beginners' cooking class on Wednesday afternoons.
sentences.zh: 我们最受欢迎的课程是周三下午的初学者烹饪课。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: It runs for eight weeks and costs ninety pounds, including all the ingredients.
sentences.zh: 课程持续八周，费用九十英镑，包含所有食材。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: We also have a free walking group that meets outside the front door at nine on Saturdays.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一个免费徒步小组，周六早上九点在前门外集合。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: The walk lasts about two hours and finishes back here for coffee.
sentences.zh: 徒步大约持续两小时，结束后回到这里喝咖啡。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: For children, there is a craft club every Friday after school.
sentences.zh: 针对孩子，每周五放学后有一个手工俱乐部。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: The craft club is free, and all the materials are provided.
sentences.zh: 手工俱乐部免费，所有材料都由我们提供。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: Places are limited to twenty, so please sign up at the desk.
sentences.zh: 名额限二十人，所以请在前台报名。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: If you'd like a printed timetable, you can pick one up from the café.
sentences.zh: 如果你想要一份纸质时间表，可以在咖啡厅拿。

sentences.speaker: Speaker
sentences.en: And if you have any questions, just ask me or any member of staff.
sentences.zh: 如果有任何问题，问我就行，或者问任何一位工作人员。

questions.question: What time does the centre open in the morning?
questions.explanation: open from eight in the morning until ten at night。eight 是开门时间，ten 是关门时间，两个数字都被念到，容易互换。

questions.question: Where is the café?
questions.explanation: On the ground floor you'll find the café and the main hall。楼上（upstairs）是小房间，front door 是徒步小组的集合点，均为位置干扰。

questions.question: How much do registered charities pay to book a room?
questions.explanation: Booking costs twelve pounds an hour, but registered charities pay nothing。but 之后才是慈善机构的情形，nothing 就是免费。

questions.question: What happens at nine o'clock on Saturday mornings?
questions.explanation: a free walking group that meets outside the front door at nine on Saturdays。烹饪课在周三下午，手工俱乐部在周五放学后，时间全部错位。

extensive.title: Discussing a Research Proposal
extensive.topic: 学生与导师讨论作业与研究方案

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Come in, Daniel. You wanted to talk about your research proposal before Friday's deadline.
sentences.zh: 进来吧，丹尼尔。你想在周五截止前谈谈你的研究方案。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Yes, thanks for seeing me. I'm still not sure my topic is narrow enough.
sentences.zh: 是的，谢谢您抽时间见我。我还是不确定我的题目够不够聚焦。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Remind me what you've settled on so far.
sentences.zh: 再跟我说一下你目前定下来的内容。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: I want to look at how cycle lanes affect small shops on high streets.
sentences.zh: 我想研究自行车道如何影响商业街上的小店铺。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: That's promising, but high streets in general is far too broad for a ten-thousand-word project.
sentences.zh: 这个想法不错，但泛泛地谈商业街，对一篇一万字的论文来说太宽了。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: I was thinking of comparing two streets in the same city, one with a new lane and one without.
sentences.zh: 我原本想比较同一座城市里的两条街，一条新修了自行车道，一条没有。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: That's much better. Two cases give you depth without losing the comparison.
sentences.zh: 这样好多了。两个案例既能保证深度，又保留了对比。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: My worry is access. I'd need sales data from the shops themselves.
sentences.zh: 我担心的是能不能拿到数据。我需要店铺自己的销售数据。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Shop owners are often reluctant, so start early and offer them anonymity.
sentences.zh: 店主通常不太愿意配合，所以你要早点开始，并向他们保证匿名。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Should I use interviews for this, or a questionnaire instead?
sentences.zh: 这个我该用访谈，还是改用问卷？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Both, but keep the questionnaire short. Fifteen questions is realistic; forty is not.
sentences.zh: 两种都用，但问卷要短。十五个问题是现实的，四十个不行。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Right. And how many interviews would be enough, roughly?
sentences.zh: 明白了。那访谈大概做多少个才够？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Aim for twelve, six on each street, and stop when you hear nothing new.
sentences.zh: 目标定在十二个，每条街六个；当你听不到新内容时就停。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: And do I need permission to record the interviews?
sentences.zh: 那录音需要征得同意吗？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Yes, use a consent form. The ethics committee has a template you can adapt.
sentences.zh: 需要，要用知情同意书。伦理委员会有一个模板，你可以改写。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Should I interview shoppers as well as owners?
sentences.zh: 除了店主，我是不是也该采访顾客？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: A few, but the shopkeepers are your main source.
sentences.zh: 可以问几个，但店主才是你的主要信息来源。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: That helps a lot. But what about the literature review section?
sentences.zh: 这很有帮助。不过文献综述那一部分呢？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Don't try to read everything. Choose four themes and organise the section around them.
sentences.zh: 不要试图读遍所有东西。选四个主题，围绕它们来组织这一部分。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: I was planning to describe each paper one by one.
sentences.zh: 我原本打算一篇一篇地介绍每篇论文。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: That's a common mistake. Readers want your argument, not a list.
sentences.zh: 这是很常见的错误。读者想看到你的论点，而不是一份清单。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Okay. And is it acceptable to use last year's traffic counts?
sentences.zh: 好的。那使用去年的交通流量数据可以吗？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Only if you explain clearly why newer figures weren't available.
sentences.zh: 只有当你能清楚解释为什么拿不到更新的数据时才可以。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Understood. I'll send you a revised outline by Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 明白了。我周三之前把修改后的提纲发给您。

questions.question: What is the student's research topic?
options: A. The cost of building new cycle lanes
B. How cycle lanes affect shops on high streets
D. How to persuade staff to cycle to work
questions.explanation: how cycle lanes affect small shops on high streets。cost、accidents、staff 三个概念原文都没有出现，属于无关干扰。

questions.question: Why does the tutor approve of comparing two streets?
options: A. It is cheaper to carry out
B. Sales data is easier to obtain
C. It gives depth while keeping a comparison
D. The department requires two case studies
questions.explanation: Two cases give you depth without losing the comparison。原文紧接着说店主 reluctant、数据难拿，B 与事实相反；D 的「系里要求」属无中生有。

questions.question: How many interviews does the tutor recommend?
options: A. Twelve, six on each street
C. As many as the student can arrange
D. Forty, twenty on each street
questions.explanation: Aim for twelve, six on each street。forty 是问卷题量的干扰数字（Fifteen questions is realistic; forty is not），两条街各六个极易混听成六个。

questions.question: What mistake does the tutor warn against in the literature review?
options: B. Organising the section by theme
C. Using sources that are too recent
D. Describing each paper one by one
questions.explanation: That's a common mistake 指的是学生说的 describe each paper one by one。按主题组织（four themes）恰是导师的建议，B 把建议说成了错误。

error_tags.label: 单词不认识
error_tags.tip: 先把这个词单独查清、读准，再回头重听整句。生词卡在句子里时，重听十遍也不会突然听懂。

error_tags.label: 单词认识但听不出
error_tags.tip: 这说明你的「视觉词汇」还没变成「听觉词汇」。把该词放进句子里跟读三遍，让耳朵记住它的真实发音，而不是拼写。

error_tags.label: 连读弱读识别困难
error_tags.tip: 挑出这一句里的虚词（of / to / and / for / can），先只听它们，你会发现它们都被压得很短。抓住重读的实词，意思就出来了。

error_tags.label: 拼写错误
error_tags.tip: 听到人名地名时立刻在草稿上跟写，别等句子结束。雅思会专门拼读字母，那几秒就是给你抄的。

error_tags.label: 数字日期识别错误
error_tags.tip: 数字题先记下所有出现的数字，再根据问题筛选。特别注意 -teen 与 -ty 的重音差别，以及 fourteen / forty 这类易混对。

error_tags.label: 关键词遗漏
error_tags.tip: 做题前先圈出题干里的名词和限定词，听的时候只盯这几个词的同义替换，不必强求听懂每一个词。

error_tags.label: 句子理解错误
error_tags.tip: 长句先找主谓宾，把从句和插入语暂时括起来。意思卡住时，先问自己「谁做了什么」，细节可以稍后再补。

error_tags.label: 注意力中断
error_tags.tip: 走神通常发生在听不懂的地方。给自己一个动作：听到序号词（first / a second factor）就立刻重新集中，答案往往在它们后面。

error_tags.label: 同义替换识别困难
error_tags.tip: 把这次没反应过来的替换对抄下来（如 almost full → not many places left），积累二十组之后，你会发现替换其实很有规律。
